reviews.comment: Overall good class. Lots of short papers and a few tests that are fairly easy and straightforward. Attendance isn't mandatory, and you can probably get away with not going super often if you have some background in the subject. Dr. Cheibub seems like a nice guy, although I interacted primarily with my TA.

His lectures are great. I love the way he teaches but he only posted the lecture videos and other than that I never heard from him. The TA ran the discussion sections but was very helpful. The class is pretty difficult because the only things that count for your grade are the summary papers and exams. Just make sure you write good papers
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: 5 papers that are two papers MAX. 3 tests that are pretty easy to wing. He has long, somewhat interesting lectures, but the material is not very difficult. Since this is a required class, I would highly recommend taking Cheibub.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I got by with an A+ in the class without watching lectures or reading and just going through slides. Five papers total in the class, but very doable. Attendance is required for recitations. Knew almost all of the material from taking previous POLS classes. GREAT option for POLS 200. He's also very accessible outside class!
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--So many papers

reviews.comment: Dr. Cheibub is a quality professor. He gets off track at times, but the class is new, and he is still adjusting the direction. In many ways, he allows the class discussion to direct the lecture. Great debate and political conversations happen in his class. He never pushes his political beliefs on his students. He is funny and very likable.

For a 400 level POLS class, this one was so incredibly easy! Dr. Cheibub is a great professor. He can be a little scattered at times, but you'll have everything you'll need to complete the assignments. Keep up on the readings for the pop quizzes, but other than that it's a pretty easy A.

Prof Cheibub is one of the best professors Ive had in my 3 years at A&M. Very smart, cares about his students, and cares about his subject a lot. Sometimes can take a while to respond to assignments & emails, but still an amazing professor and one A&M is lucky to have!

Professor Cheibub is one of the most influential minds in the field of Comparative Politics and A&M is lucky to have him. My class was a 489, so it was a bit experimental/fluid(reading and assignments were changed or scraped mid semester) . Cheibub is a fair grader, he focuses on you understanding the concept. Only complaint is late feedback
